name: JARVIS Shell
description: Run programs and shell scripts as the current user. Use for git, python, file operations, and any command that does not require elevated privileges.
summary: User-level shell execution for JARVIS. Runs programs and scripts as the logged-in user. No sudo — use jarvis-shell-system-mcp for privileged commands.

tools.name: execute_command
tools.description: Execute a program and return its stdout, stderr, and exit code

tools.name: execute_script
tools.description: Execute a multi-line shell script via /bin/sh and return its output
